cases.goal: retain a structured draft across navigation and reload without leaking or overwriting it across origins

navigate within the origin and reload
visit a second origin and write the same keys

cases.goal: share a saved draft across independent same-origin tabs while keeping each tab session private and usable after peer close
cases.initial_state: one fresh standalone Profile; two independently created tabs with no opener
actions: write a shared Unicode draft and tab-A session marker
open a second same-origin tab and verify shared draft but empty session
edit the shared draft and set tab-B session marker
reload both tabs and verify shared content with distinct sessions
close tab B and continue editing in tab A
limitations: no independent Profile or managed-domain qualification
no restart durability or authenticated/live-site workflow

cases.goal: keep same-site drafts and cookie state private to each Profile while another Profile edits, clears data and exits
cases.initial_state: two simultaneous standalone Profiles with separate storage paths and leases, identical environment seed and the same loopback origin
actions: write a Unicode draft, session marker and cookie in Profile A
launch Profile B and verify all three values are absent
write distinct values under the same keys in B and reload both Profiles
clear B storage and cookie, reload B and close it
verify A data is unchanged and continue editing in A
limitations: script-visible cookie isolation, not a login or HTTP credential test
no browser restart durability or live-site workflow

enter fixture credentials with native input and submit the form
follow Set-Cookie and redirect to private content
verify HttpOnly is hidden from script and reload keeps access
submit logout and verify a new private request is denied
limitations: local fixture credentials only; no real identity provider
HTTP only; no TLS or Secure-cookie qualification
no restart persistence, cross-site or managed-domain qualification
